name: Hesai
sub: EXT color-detecting LiDAR heading to 2026 mass production
regions: China, US, Europe, global robotaxi and ADAS programs
about: Large Chinese LiDAR supplier serving ADAS, robotaxi, trucking, robotics and industrial markets.
model: Sells LiDAR sensors and related perception components to OEMs and AV developers.
deployment: High-volume China ADAS supply plus robotaxi and AV customers globally
metrics: Fourth consecutive GAAP-profitable quarter in Q1 2026 (shipments +141% YoY to ~472,000 units) after a first full-year profit in 2025; strategic lidar supplier for Mercedes-Benz L3 programs; Picasso 6D lidar chip unveiled and ETX series targeting H2 2026 mass production; ADAS-class units from ~$200, robotaxi-grade near $3,000.
signal: One of the two densest LiDAR nodes in China and a global benchmark supplier

sources.title: Hesai sustains profitability as LiDAR shipments surge and secures Mercedes order
